title: Fish Shopping content pack
description: Canonical game content shared by the Android (Kotlin) and web (TypeScript) clients. Structural rules live here; cross-reference rules (IDs exist, no unlock cycles, zones reachable) are enforced by each client's content validator.

startCatchSpeedPermille.description: 1000 = normal catch duration; higher finishes casts faster.

startFishRegenPermille.description: 1000 = normal spot regen; higher restocks empty spots faster.

timingWindowStartPermille.description: Cast progress (0..1000) where the Good reel window opens.

timingWindowEndPermille.description: Cast progress (0..1000) where the Good reel window closes (exclusive).

timingPerfectStartPermille.description: Cast progress where the Perfect reel zone opens (must sit inside the Good window).

timingPerfectEndPermille.description: Cast progress where the Perfect reel zone closes (exclusive).

timingGoodBonusPermille.description: Tip payout for a Good reel as permille of species baseValue (500 = half).

timingPerfectBonusPermille.description: Tip payout for a Perfect reel as permille of species baseValue (1000 = full).

spoilTier.description: Bag spoil priority: 3 fragile (removed first), 2 standard, 1 hardy (removed last). Defaults to 2.

chancePermille.description: Chance in 1/1000 that a successful catch upgrades to [to].

spoilTier.description: Counter spoil priority: 3 fragile (removed first), 2 standard, 1 preserved (removed last). Defaults to 2.

bait.description: Consumable pier bait (Phase 9). Bought at kiosk zones; carried in the player bag.

packQuantity.description: Units added to the bag per kiosk purchase.

rareSpeciesWeightMultPermille.description: Weight multiplier for species that have a rareUpgrade chain (1000 = unchanged).

rareChanceBonusPermille.description: Added to the rare-upgrade roll chance when this bait is active.

requires.description: Upgrade/quest ids that must be owned before the kiosk will sell this bait.

speedPermille.description: Catch speed multiplier in permille (1250 = 25% faster).

bait.description: Bait item granted into the player bag on purchase (not re-applied on load).

windowStartPermille.description: Widens Good window start via min(current, this).

windowEndPermille.description: Widens Good window end via max(current, this).

perfectStartPermille.description: Widens Perfect zone start via min(current, this).

perfectEndPermille.description: Widens Perfect zone end via max(current, this).

speedPermille.description: Fish-spot regen multiplier in permille (1250 = 25% faster).

zone.description: Fishing zone unlocked when this upgrade is owned.

machine.description: Machine family unlocked when this upgrade is owned; stations using it must list this upgrade as requiresUpgrade.

pad.description: Counter pad kind unlocked when this upgrade is owned; matching counters must list this upgrade as requiresUpgrade.

speedPermille.description: Staff walk-speed multiplier in permille (1250 = 25% faster).

capacityUnits.description: Minimum bag capacity for hired staff.

speedPermille.description: Minimum fisher catch-speed permille (applies if higher than the role default).

coinsPerWorkerPerHour.description: Coins charged per hired worker each simulated hour.

periodMultPermille.description: Multiplies bag fish spoilage period (2000 = half as fast).
Multiplies counter product spoilage period (2000 = half as fast).

kind.description: Presentation/economy tier (Phase 11 archetypes: tourist, wholesaler, critic, night_regular).

priceMultPermille.description: Sale price multiplier in permille (1500 = 50% tip for premium visitors).

preferredProducts.description: Weighted product demand; empty means any accepted counter product.

unmetPriceMultPermille.description: Extra price multiplier when the basket is not all preferred product (750 = 25% less).

unmetPatienceDrainPermille.description: Patience drain per tick while preferred stock is missing (2000 = 2x).

dayPartSpawnMultPermille.description: Optional per day-part spawn weight multipliers (1000 = unchanged). Keys must match ecology.parts ids.

workers.description: Hireable worker roles (Phase 11+). FISHER catches fish; PORTER hauls machine output to the counter.

catchSpeedPermille.description: Used by fisher casts (1000 = normal species catchTicks).

leaseTicks.description: How long a claimed haul reservation lasts before it is released.

requires.description: Upgrade or quest IDs that must be owned/completed before this role can be hired.

staffProgression.description: Per-worker XP, levels, and hire-time trait rolls (Phase 16).

xpThresholds.description: Cumulative XP required for levels 1..N (index 0 must be 0).

moveSpeedPermillePerLevel.description: Added move-speed permille per level above 1.

catchSpeedPermillePerLevel.description: Added catch-speed permille per level above 1.

carryBonusEveryLevels.description: +1 bag capacity every N levels (levels above 1).

xpSaleAssisted.description: XP granted to an on-duty cashier when a sale completes at their pad.

shifts.description: On-shift slots vs overtime wages; supervisor expands free slots (Phase 17).

baseOnShiftSlots.description: Workers that can be on shift at the standard wage rate.

overtimeWagePermille.description: Wage multiplier for on-shift workers beyond free slots (1500 = 1.5x).

supervisorExtraSlots.description: Added free on-shift slots while a supervisor is posted on shift.

roleBuffs.description: Passive buffs for Phase 18 specialized hireable roles.

greeterPatienceDrainMultPermille.description: Multiplies customer patience drain while a greeter is posted (700 = 30% slower drain).

smokerSpecialistProcessSpeedPermille.description: Smoker batch speed while a smoker specialist is posted (1250 = 25% faster).

iceRunnerFragileSpoilTierMin.description: Ice runners prioritize hauling products at or above this spoil tier.

iceRunnerSpoilScoreBonus.description: Added haul score for ice_packed_crate or fragile spoil-tier items.

loadouts.description: Assignable staff gear slots (Phase 19). Owned worker_* upgrades equip to one worker each.

upgradeIds.description: Upgrade IDs that fill this slot (must use worker_move_speed / worker_carry / worker_catch_speed).

transferIntervalMultPermille.description: Multiplies transfer interval (1000 = unchanged; lower = faster).

urgencyWeight.description: Weight for source fullness / OUTPUT_FULL urgency when scoring haul tasks.

distanceWeight.description: Weight for proximity (closer sources score higher).

demandWeight.description: Weight for destination demand (waiting customers, empty stock, hungry machines).

supervisorDemandBoostPermille.description: Multiplies demandWeight while a supervisor is on duty (1000 = unchanged).

automationAlerts.description: Staff automation goals and rush idle ticker alerts (Phase 20).

machineIdleTicksDuringRush.description: Ticks a station may stay WAITING_FOR_INPUT or OUTPUT_FULL during a rush before a ticker alert.

alertCooldownTicks.description: Minimum ticks between idle alerts for the same station.

capHours.description: Maximum real-time hours credited as offline simulation ticks.

summaryMinSeconds.description: Minimum absence (seconds) before the offline summary screen is shown.

ecology.description: Harbor day-part cycle that scales fishing-spot regen (and tide-chart catch speed).

dayLengthTicks.description: Ticks in one dawn→night cycle (tick % dayLengthTicks).

id.description: Day-part id (no dotted namespace; referenced by fishingSpots.dayPartRegenMultPermille).

endPermille.description: Exclusive end of this part within the day (parts must end at 1000).

regenMultPermille.description: Spot regen duration multiplier (1000 = normal; higher = slower restock).

catchSpeedMultPermille.description: Applied to player cast speed when a tide chart is owned.

requires.description: Quest or upgrade IDs that must be completed/owned before sinks apply.

maintenanceCoinsPerStation.description: Coins charged per harbor station each maintenance cycle.

counterSpoilPeriodTicks.description: Ticks between soft counter stock losses.

counterSpoilUnits.description: Max product units removed from counters each spoil cycle.

bagFishSpoilPeriodTicks.description: Ticks between soft raw-fish losses from the player bag.

bagFishSpoilUnits.description: Max species units removed from the player bag each spoil cycle.

scarcityPriceCurvePermille.description: Phase 12 scarcity sale multipliers for counter fill bands 0–20% … 80–100% (1000 = unchanged).

wear.description: Phase 25 machine wear / disaster checks after a late-game gate.

requires.description: Quest/upgrade IDs before wear events can fire.

trophies.description: Museum / trophy board (Phase 10): size rolls on catch and curated species sets.

sizeMinPermille.description: Inclusive lower bound for specimen size rolls (permille of species baseValue).

sizeMaxPermille.description: Inclusive upper bound for specimen size rolls.

species.description: Species that must each have a personal-best trophy to complete the set.

completeStat.description: Stat set to 1 when the collection is complete (prestige goals can target it).

requires.description: Quest, upgrade, or prestige IDs that unlock the prestige board.

ratingThresholds.description: Lifetime thresholds for harbor rating stars 1..5 (must be non-decreasing).

ratingPriceMultPermille.description: Phase 12 soft sale multipliers for harbor rating stars 0..5 (1000 = unchanged).

catchSpeedPermille.description: 0 = no catch bonus; otherwise permanent catch-speed floor (permille).

priceBonusPermille.description: 0 = no price bonus; otherwise permanent sale price multiplier floor (permille).

cosmetic.description: Optional cosmetic / banner flag unlocked on completion.

reputation.description: Phase 13 service reputation from served vs abandoned. Distinct from prestige harbor rating.

minSample.description: Encounters needed before the score leaves the neutral placeholder.

neutralScorePermille.description: Score used while encounters are below minSample.

scoreBandThresholdsPermille.description: Non-decreasing thresholds that split score into bands (N thresholds → N+1 bands).

items.description: CustomerKind.wire → spawn weight multiplier for one reputation band.

kindSpawnMultPermille.description: Per-band spawn multipliers; length must equal scoreBandThresholdsPermille.length + 1.

unmetPreferencePenaltyPermille.description: Soft score penalty: unmetPreferenceSales * this / max(1, sales).

coachingLostRatioPermille.description: Lost/encounters ratio that triggers a walkout coaching tip.

coachingPraiseScorePermille.description: Score that triggers a praise tip once minSample is met.

kind.description: Phase 14: one-shot standard job or auto-refresh standing order.

payoutEscalatePermille.description: Standing: multiply payout by this / 1000 per completed cycle (capped by maxStreak).

penaltyEscalatePermille.description: Standing: multiply penalty by this / 1000 per completed cycle (capped by maxStreak).

maxStreak.description: Standing: max escalate steps applied to payout/penalty.

failCooldownTicks.description: Standing: ticks the template stays off the board after a failed run.

requiresSeasonalEvent.description: Phase 24: only post this template while the named seasonal event is active.

bank.description: Phase 26 short-term loans (interest sink) and coin-goal presets.

requires.description: Quest/upgrade IDs before the bank is available.

loanPrincipal.description: Coins granted when taking a loan.

collectionPeriodTicks.description: While overdue, seize owed coins this often.

goalPresets.description: Coin-goal targets offered in the Goals panel.

seasonalEvents.description: Phase 24 time-boxed overlays driven by the sim clock (no live server).

banner.description: Cosmetic / banner id unlocked when the event first becomes active.

speciesWeightMultPermille.description: Catch-weight multipliers for listed species while the event is active.

decor.description: Phase 23 shop decor / placable cosmetics. Owned pieces add a tiny customer patience buff.

requiresCosmetic.description: Optional prestige banner / cosmetic id that must already be unlocked.

patienceBonusTicks.description: Added to newly spawned customer patience while this decor is owned.

requires.description: Quest or upgrade IDs that must be completed/owned before travel to this harbor.

regenCurvePermille.description: Regen duration multipliers at stock ratios 0..1 (empty is slower = stock pressure).

dayPartRegenMultPermille.description: Optional per-day-part regen multipliers keyed by ecology.parts[].id (overrides the global part regenMult).

requiresUpgrade.description: Optional upgrade that must be owned before this spot can be fished.
Optional upgrade that must be owned before this station accepts transfers or runs batches.

kind.description: Sell channel. Wholesale pads take crate-sized B2B products; cashiers route by demand.

products.description: Products this counter accepts for stocking and sale (sorted order is used when filling baskets).

queueAnchor.description: Ground position of queue slot 0 (customers stand here to be served).

queueStep.description: Offset from one queue slot to the next.

footprint.description: Optional presentation hint: the obstacle whose top shows the stock.

requiresUpgrade.description: Optional upgrade that must be owned before this counter accepts stock, spawns, or cashier coverage.

plots.description: Phase 6 expansion markers: walk onto the plot zone, inspect, confirm spend to grant an unlock upgrade.

zone.description: Zone of kind plot the player must stand in to build.

grantsUpgrade.description: Upgrade granted atomically on confirm (unlock_machine / unlock_counter / unlock_fishing_spot).

customerPathWaypoints.description: Intermediate points for the customer approach polyline (entry → waypoints → queue slot). Empty means a straight walk. Segments must stay on open walkable ground.

rushes.description: Periodic rush windows that spike customer spawn rate and queue capacity. Active when (tick % periodTicks) is in [startTick, startTick + durationTicks).

periodTicks.description: Length of the repeating day/cycle in ticks.

startTick.description: Offset within the period when the rush begins (inclusive).

spawnSpeedPermille.description: Spawn rate multiplier (1000 = normal). Interval = customerSpawnTicks * 1000 / spawnSpeedPermille.

queueBonus.description: Extra queue slots available at every counter while this rush is active.

priceMultPermille.description: Phase 12 sale price multiplier while this rush is active (1000 = unchanged).

specialization.description: Phase 22 per-harbor passive applied while the player is at this harbor.

maintenanceDiscountPerStation.description: Subtracted from economy.maintenanceCoinsPerStation (with upgrade discounts) while at this harbor.

rareChanceBonusPermille.description: Added to rare-upgrade rolls while fishing at this harbor.

kindSpawnMultPermille.description: Customer-kind spawn multipliers while at this harbor (keys = customer kind wires).
